description: AI agent that answers natural language questions by generating and executing SQL/KQL queries against Fabric data sources. Configurable with data source bindings, few-shot examples, and custom instructions. Can be published for use in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

definition_parts.description: Few-shot Q&A examples per data source

notes: Max 5 datasources per agent, max 100 fewshots per datasource
Publish copies draft/* to published/* and adds publish_info.json
Datasource types: lakehouse_tables, data_warehouse, kusto, semantic_model, graph
Full definition required for datasource persistence (not single-part updates)

Datasource topics are Preview Markdown files. List/download support staging and published state; upload/format/delete operate on staging. Upload replaces a same-named topic and supports If-Match ETags.
